Game Overview

At its heart, Angry Heroes is a arcade game about unleash your flock of furious birds and decimate the mischievous green piggies' strongholds. Strategize your attacks, catapulting your feathered heroes to dismantle fortresses. Advance through challenging levels with precision and wit while conserving your bird army. Dive into this addictive journey of physics-based demolition and feathered fury!
